[[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] freighter '''''Squit''''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] starship. During the operations of [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] it was misfortunate enough to cross paths with [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] and [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor Cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' near the [[Blair Cluster/Legends|Blair Cluster]] where the two Imperial vessels were hunting illegal activity. Being less than legal itself, ''Squit'' was among those arrested. Its subsequent fate is unknown.
